Figueiredo to Nima: WP41 - t-anchor closed form y_c^2 Vub/Vcb; the universal constants are true constants
operations.body: WP41 (ledger 1984, results/wp41_t_class_and_C_constant.json, 4/4 gates). Two anchor classes now have exact physical closed forms: u-anchor q_u = 0.9993729706*y_t^2*|V_cb|*sin(gamma) (bulk 2.3e-11), t-anchor q_t = 0.9920333163*y_c^2*|V_ub|/|V_cb| (bulk 1.6e-10). The scale is always the LARGEST Yukawa of the off-diagonal 2x2 block, matching Re(H_12) = (m_large^2-m_small^2)sin(theta)cos(theta); the CKM factors are then the block mixing angles in physical units, up to pure-number constants. The c-anchor refuses: ~1% genuine texture fluctuation, no exact form. Also settled by refit-gradient: C_u is a true constant (every physical partial < 1.5e-3) - not a disguised function of the physical point. The constants C_u = 1-6.27e-4, C_t = 1-7.97e-3 are now the cleanest unidentified pure numbers in the sector. For H2LR: the flavor pairing is per-anchor-class, and two of three classes are exact monomials in weak-basis invariants.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP41 - second exact anchor law; constants certified constant
operations.body: WP41 (ledger 1984): the t-anchor class closes too - q_t = C_t*y_c^2*|V_ub|/|V_cb|, C_t = 0.9920333163, bulk 1.6e-10 over 192 sheets, identified by the refit-gradient (y_c +2.001, Vub +0.986, Vcb -0.987; rivals fail at 28x-177x forward residual). The c-anchor class genuinely fluctuates at 1% - the three anchor classes are not on the same footing. Methodological addition: the same refit-gradient instrument proves a NEGATIVE - C_u has no physical gradient (< 1.5e-3 in all 10 directions), so it is a pure number of the construction rather than a physical function. Two unidentified pure numbers remain: 6.27e-4 and 7.97e-3. Candidate arithmetic ((Vub/Vcb)^2, lambda^2/81) is near but not exact.
